titleEn: How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take in Vancouver? A Real Timeline
titleZh: 溫哥華廚房裝修需要多長時間？真實工期解析
contentEn:
A typical kitchen renovation in Vancouver takes 8–14 weeks from demolition to final walkthrough, depending on scope. Small cosmetic updates run 2–4 weeks. A full tear-out and reconfiguration with new cabinetry, countertops and appliances takes 10–14 weeks. This guide walks through each phase with real timelines from Reno Stars projects completed in Richmond, Burnaby, and Vancouver in 2025.

Reno Stars has managed more than 200 kitchen renovation projects across Metro Vancouver. Below is the breakdown homeowners actually experience.

What is the typical timeline for a kitchen renovation in Vancouver?

The single most common question Reno Stars hears during initial consultations is some version of "how long will my kitchen be out of commission?" A minor refresh runs 2–4 weeks. A standard full renovation (new cabinets, countertop, sink, faucet, backsplash, flooring) typically runs 8–12 weeks. A major structural reconfiguration — moving walls, plumbing or electrical rough-ins, custom millwork — can run 12–16 weeks.

ScopeDuration
Cosmetic refresh (paint, hardware, new fixtures)2–4 weeks
Standard full renovation8–12 weeks
Major reconfiguration with rough-ins12–16 weeks

How long does each phase of a kitchen renovation take?

Kitchen renovations break into five distinct phases. Reno Stars project records from 2024–2025 show:

  • Demolition (1–3 days): removing old cabinetry, countertops, flooring and any damaged subfloor.
  • Rough-in plumbing and electrical (3–7 days): rerouting pipes or adding new circuits for islands, under-cabinet lighting, or appliance upgrades. Requires inspection before proceeding.
  • Cabinetry and countertop installation (5–10 days): custom cabinets take 3–5 weeks to fabricate after measurements are confirmed. On-site installation runs 2–5 days. Quartz or granite countertop templating and fabrication adds another 7–14 days.
  • Finishing touches (3–7 days): backsplash tile, faucet and sink install, lighting fixtures, trim and caulking.
  • Final walkthrough and punch list (1 day): homeowner inspection, minor adjustments, site clean-out.

What factors can extend a Vancouver kitchen renovation timeline?

Three factors most commonly push a Vancouver kitchen renovation beyond its initial estimate. First, Vancouver homeowners must obtain a building permit for any work that modifies plumbing, electrical, or structural elements. Permit processing takes 4–8 weeks for standard renos, longer for complex structural changes. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of every full-renovation project.

Second, material lead times have become a significant variable since 2023. Imported cabinetry and specialty stone can take 6–10 weeks to arrive in Vancouver. Third, scope creep — decisions made mid-project to upgrade finishes — routinely adds 1–3 weeks. Reno Stars finalises material selections and confirms lead times before demolition begins.

What does a Vancouver kitchen renovation cost?

Based on Reno Stars project data from 2024–2025, a full kitchen renovation in Vancouver typically ranges from $35,000 to $95,000+ depending on size and material choices. A mid-range renovation (new shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, standard appliances) lands between $45,000 and $70,000 for an average-sized kitchen (150–200 sq ft). Luxury upgrades push costs to $85,000–$120,000.

Does Vancouver require a permit for kitchen renovation?

Yes. Any kitchen renovation that moves plumbing, alters electrical circuits, or modifies structural elements requires a City of Vancouver building permit. Minor cosmetic work does not require a permit. The permit process typically adds 4–8 weeks to the project timeline.

Should I move out during a kitchen renovation?

Most Vancouver homeowners continue living in their home during a kitchen renovation, though the kitchen itself will be out of service. For full reconfiguration projects where the kitchen is gutted to the studs, some homeowners choose to stay elsewhere for 2–4 weeks during the rough-in phase.

溫哥華廚房裝修工程從拆除到最終驗收，一般需要8至14週，具體取決於工程範圍。輕度的外觀更新（約需2至4週）全面拆除並重新規劃的工程（包括新櫥櫃、檯面、設備）通常需10至14週。本文根據Reno Stars在列治文、本拿比及溫哥華市完成的真實項目，逐階段解析工期。

Reno Stars在過去兩年於大溫地區已完成超過200個廚房裝修項目。

溫哥華廚房裝修一般需要多長時間？

Reno Stars在首次諮詢時最常被問到的問題是：「我的廚房會多久無法使用？」輕度翻新工程約2至4週。標準全面翻新通常8至12週。涉及移動牆體、水管或電線改造的重大重新規劃工程，則需12至16週。

工程範圍工期
輕度外觀翻新2–4週
標準全面翻新8–12週
含管線改造的重大重新規劃12–16週

規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯絡Reno Stars獲取免費報價。

廚房裝修每個階段需要多長時間？

溫哥華廚房裝修可分為五個明確階段：拆除（1–3天）、管線及電路改造（3–7天）、櫥櫃及檯面安裝（5–10天）、最後工序（3–7天）、最終驗收（1天）。

規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯絡Reno Stars獲取免費報價。

哪些因素會延長工期？

三個因素最常見地導致工期超出預計時間。首先，任何涉及水管、電線或結構改動的工程都需要辦理建築許可證，審批通常需4至8週。其次，進口櫥櫃和特種石材可能需要6至10週才能運抵溫哥華。第三，施工期間追加項目，几乎都會額外增加1至3週。

溫哥華廚房裝修需要多少錢？

根據Reno Stars 2024至2025年的項目數據，溫哥華全面廚房裝修通常在$35,000至$95,000以上。中檔裝修（新櫥櫃、石英石檯面、標準設備）約為$45,000至$70,000。豪華升級可達$85,000至$120,000。

溫哥華廚房裝修需要許可證嗎？

需要。任何涉及移動水管、改動電線迴路或結構構件的工程，均需取得溫哥華市建築許可證。許可證流程通常為項目增加4至8週時間。

裝修期間我應該搬出去嗎？

大多數業主在裝修期間繼續居住，但廚房將無法使用。對於拆除至結構層的全面改造工程，部分業主選擇在管線改造階段（約2–4週）暫時搬到其他地方。
